raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that the Wanli Emperor’s father was the Jiajing Emperor (Zhu Houcong) and thus that Wang Xijie’s father-in-law was Jiajing, instead of correctly identifying the Longqing Emperor (Zhu Zaiji). This genealogical misidentification set the analysis on the wrong path and was compounded later by briefly conflating “father-in-law” with the subject’s own father (Wang Wei), indicating failure to verify lineage before concluding.
